messages.content: You are an expert evaluator of AI assistant answers.

You are an expert judge evaluating the quality of two AI assistants' answers to the same user question. Compare them on helpfulness, relevance, accuracy, and completeness. One answer was produced first in the conversation (position 1), the other later (position 2). Do not favour either position: if an answer is longer, credit it only if the extra text is actually useful.

--- QUESTION (USER) ---
Imagine you are writing a blog post comparing two popular smartphone models. Develop an outline for the blog post, including key points and subheadings to effectively compare and contrast the features, performance, and user experience of the two models. Please answer in fewer than 200 words.

--- ANSWER 1 (from AI Assistant A) ---
I. Introduction
A. Explanation of the purpose of the blog post
B. Brief overview of the two smartphone models being compared

II. Design and Build
A. Physical appearance and dimensions
B. Materials used and durability
C. Display and camera quality
D. Ergonomics and comfort

III. Performance
A. Processor and memory
B. Battery life and charging
C. Operating system and user interface
D. Gaming and multitasking capabilities

IV. User Experience
A. Interface and customization options
B. Software features and apps
C. Connectivity and networking
D. Accessibility and inclusivity

V. Price and Value
A. Cost of the devices
B. Extra features and accessories
C. Warranty and customer service
D. Resale value and market demand

VI. Conclusion
A. Recap of the key points
B. Final thoughts and recommendations
C. Suggestions for further research or comparison.

--- ANSWER 2 (from AI Assistant B) ---
Both models have a lot to offer in terms of features and performance, but each offers something unique. Let’s take a closer look at the two models to see what makes them stand out.
The first model has a longer battery life and a more responsive touchscreen, while the second model offers a faster processor and a sharper camera.

First write a short explanation (2-4 sentences) comparing the two answers and what you found decisive. Then, on a final line by itself, give your verdict using exactly one of these labels:

Judge: A

Judge: B

Judge: tie

response:
Assistant A provides a comprehensive, structured, and highly usable outline format suitable for a blog post comparison. It uses standard, logical headings (Introduction, Design, Performance, etc.) that guide the writer through all necessary comparison points. Assistant B, conversely, appears to be a collection of comparative statements or bullet points rather than a cohesive outline structure. While it attempts to compare features, it lacks the organizational framework requested by the prompt. Therefore, Assistant A is significantly more helpful and relevant to the specific request for an *outline*.

Judge: A
